sql.query: INSERT INTO tbl_tenant_branding (tenantId,primaryColour,accentColour,headerColour,sidebarColour,defaultColourMode,createdByUserId,modifiedByUserId) SELECT :tenantId,UPPER(:primaryColour),UPPER(:accentColour),UPPER(:headerColour),UPPER(:sidebarColour),:colourMode,:userId,:modifiedUserId FROM DUAL WHERE :primaryColour2 REGEXP '^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$' AND :accentColour2 REGEXP '^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$' AND :headerColour2 REGEXP '^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$' AND :sidebarColour2 REGEXP '^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$' AND :colourMode2 IN ('light','dark','system') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=utr.roleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='branding.manage' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:permissionUser AND utr.tenantId=:permissionTenant AND utr.isActive=1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE primaryColour=VALUES(primaryColour),accentColour=VALUES(accentColour),headerColour=VALUES(headerColour),sidebarColour=VALUES(sidebarColour),defaultColourMode=VALUES(defaultColourMode),rowVersion=rowVersion+1,modifiedByUserId=VALUES(modifiedByUserId),modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
